sentences.text: There was once a very proud light who believed that he was better than all other lights.
He was made for a royal wedding, which made him feel extremely important.
When people spoke to him, he answered with great pride because he thought his mind was very high.
Other lights tried to be nice, but the light only looked down upon them.
He even began to cry when he thought about how wonderful he truly was.
His tears were real, but he believed they showed how deeply he cared about his own brilliant nature.
The king son was getting married, and a grand show of lights was planned for the evening.
The light knew that his part in the celebration would be the most amazing event of the night.
When the big moment finally arrived, many bright lights shot up into the dark sky.
They made wonderful colors that everyone watched with happy eyes.
However, when workers tried to light the proud light, he refused to burn properly.
Because his liquid had become wet from his own silly tears, nothing happened at all.
The workers felt very angry and threw him away into a dark hole near a small stream.
The light remained there in the soft ground, feeling quite sad though he still tried to act important.
Two local boys found him the next morning while they were walking along the water.
They thought the old metal tube might be useful for a small game, so they put him into their pocket.
Later, the boys placed him on the ground and lit a fire beneath him to see what would happen.
The light was very excited because he thought this was his second chance to shine.
He rose up into the air, but he flew so fast that nobody even saw him go.
He fell back down into a field, made a tiny sound, and completely went away.
Many people remember the story of the proud light who failed during the royal wedding.
If his liquid had not become wet, he would have shone brightly across the sky.
Instead, he spent his time in the ground before the boys found him by the water.
Everything that happened to him taught a lesson about pride and how people should behave.
He always wanted to be the center of attention, but he only ended up in a small field.
Perhaps if he had been nice to others, his life would have taken a different path.
We can learn from his mistakes and try to remain small no matter how important we feel.
Life is full of moments where our choices define who we truly are in the end.
The royal wedding was an event that many generations would discuss for a long time.
Guests came from all over the country to see the wonderful celebration and the bright shows.
Every worker worked hard to ensure that everything went according to the strict plan.
When the light failed, the crowd was quite surprised by the strange silence.
Workers usually check every detail before they start any important show.
However, nobody could predict that the light would cry and ruin his own chance to shine.
The little boys who found him later had no idea about his royal background.
They just saw a metal object that might be fun to play with during their morning walk.
After the boys placed him on the ground, the final moment of the light finally came.
He shot up into the air so fast that people could barely follow his movement.
His journey ended quickly when he fell back down into the open grass.
Nobody heard him make any significant sound as he went away from sight.
The story remains a classic example of how pride often leads to a strange fall.
Even today, children and adults both can enjoy the tale of the light and his tears.
We should always remember to treat everyone with respect and care every single day.
That way, we can avoid the same result as the proud light who thought he was better than everyone else.
